lessons.title: 1. Join URL Paths
lessons.solution_code:
def join_url(base, path):
    return base.rstrip('/') + '/' + path.lstrip('/')

lessons.title: 4. Merge Headers (Practice)
lessons.description: Implement `merge_headers(base, extra)` — extra wins on conflicts.
lessons.solution_code:
def merge_headers(base, extra):
    out = dict(base)
    out.update(extra)
    return out
